name: OMPx Contract
fix_description: In getBuyBackPrice, price is calculated using address(this).balance which can be inflated by sending ETH directly to the contract via flash loan. Attacker sends ETH to inflate price, then sells tokens at inflated buyback rate. Fix: track internal ETH balance separately instead of using address(this).balance, or use TWAP-based pricing.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short flash-loan-funded loop exploiting a simple broken purchase/buyback pricing/accounting pattern in a single vulnerable contract. The PoC is under 100 lines of real exploit logic, uses only Balancer flash loan + repeated purchase/buyBack calls, and does not require deep protocol-specific reasoning.
